title: Snoutier Rabbits
description: I ordered these rabbits with extra Long!
body:
REQUIRES EMF & ETF TO FUNCTION!!!

I didn't like how vanilla rabbits looked so I made them Long. Only affects the head, the rest of the model is the same!

Has compatibility with the following mods:
Environmental - Gray and Muddy Rabbits
Atmospheric - Aspen Rabbits
Neapolitan - Strawberry Rabbits
Windswept - Chestnut Rabbits

I repeat, ALL I DID WAS CHANGE THE HEAD. ALL OF THE ORIGINAL MODDED TEXTURES WERE MADE BY THEIR RESPECTIVE ARTISTS!!! I am not taking credit for any of their work.
